يستعصم (form X)
# يَسْتَعْصِمُ (yastaʕṣimu) /jas.taʕ.sˤi.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
# يُسْتَعْصَمُ (yustaʕṣamu) /jus.taʕ.sˤa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
# يَسْتَعْصِمَ (yastaʕṣima) /jas.taʕ.sˤi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْ
